import numpy as np, itertools, math, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
bases="TCAG"; AAs="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={x+y+z:AAs[n] for n,(x,y,z) in enumerate(itertools.product(bases,repeat=3))}
def sites(c):
    N=Sy=0.0
    for pos in range(3):
        syn=sum(1 for b in "ACGT" if b!=c[pos] and CODON[c[:pos]+b+c[pos+1:]]==CODON[c])
        Sy+=syn/3.0; N+=(3-syn)/3.0
    return Sy,N
def path_diff(c1,c2):
    d=[i for i in range(3) if c1[i]!=c2[i]]
    if not d: return 0.0,0.0
    sd=nd=0.0; np_=0
    for perm in itertools.permutations(d):
        cur=c1; s=n=0; ok=True
        for p in perm:
            nxt=cur[:p]+c2[p]+cur[p+1:]
            if CODON[nxt]=="*": ok=False; break
            if CODON[nxt]==CODON[cur]: s+=1
            else: n+=1
            cur=nxt
        if ok: sd+=s; nd+=n; np_+=1
    return (sd/np_, nd/np_) if np_ else (0.0,float(len(d)))
def jc(p): return None if p>=0.75 else -0.75*math.log(1-4*p/3)
# Dmel-Dsec codon alignment is gapless over Dmel 1-85 (verified in previous cell); rebuild it explicitly
pm="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
ps="MDDTLSTVEGGMAETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMALGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCVLPCSACLACDEGCCGDDGEGG-----GGGCC-------DCGDGCGDCSLDDD"
cm=""
cs=""
cod=lambda s:[s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(s)-3,3)]
cmL,csL=cod(cm),cod(cs)
i=j=0; pairsC=[]; melpos=[]
for x,y in zip(pm,ps):
    if x!='-' and y!='-': pairsC.append((cmL[i],csL[j])); melpos.append(i+1); i+=1; j+=1
    elif x=='-': j+=1
    else: i+=1
regions={"N-terminal Thr-rich (1-34)":(1,34),"TM helix (35-69)":(35,69),"Cys/Gly/Asp tail (70-120)":(70,120)}
rows=[]
for nm,(lo,hi) in regions.items():
    Ss=Ns=Sd=Nd=0.0; nc=0
    for (c1,c2),mp in zip(pairsC,melpos):
        if not (lo<=mp<=hi): continue
        nc+=1
        s1,n1=sites(c1); s2,n2=sites(c2); Ss+=(s1+s2)/2; Ns+=(n1+n2)/2
        sd,nd=path_diff(c1,c2); Sd+=sd; Nd+=nd
    pS,pN=Sd/Ss,Nd/Ns; dS,dN=jc(pS),jc(pN)
    rows.append(dict(region=nm,codons_aligned=nc,Sd=round(Sd,1),Nd=round(Nd,1),
                     pS=round(pS,4),pN=round(pN,4),dS=round(dS,4),dN=round(dN,4),
                     omega=round(dN/dS,3) if dS>0 else None))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("Regional dN/dS, D. melanogaster vs D. sechellia\n")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# 4-species conservation per Dmel residue
prot={"D. melanogaster":pm.replace("-",""),
 "D. sechellia":"MDDTLSTVEGGMAETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMALGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCVLPCSACLACDEGCCGDDGEGGGGGCCDCGDGCGDCSLDDD",
 "D. suzukii":"MEDTLAPEDSSEPTTVAPVYVVDWGSYSWSTTVATTTTTAASKGSSGPMGVGIIVLIVFVVLLCCLFIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACFTCGDGCCGDGGEGGGGDGCCGDGCGDDCCGDDCCGDKGGGGGGEECCDGCGDCNVDDD",
 "D. gunungcola":"MAEELTDATVATVSEVYVTQWVADTVTTTIATITTTEKSSGGGGIGVAIIVLIVFFVLLLCLCIICLPLLCLLGCCGLACSPCLACGDGCCGEGCCGEGGGDACGDGCCGGADEGDDGCCGGGGCGGDDCCGDDD"}
print("\nCysteine counts:", {k:v.count("C") for k,v in prot.items()})
print("Invariant core motif present in all four species: 'IICLPLLCL' ->", all("IICLPLLCL" in v for v in prot.values()))
print("'CGCC' present in all four:", all("CGCC" in v for v in prot.values()))
print("'ACS' + 'C' tract 'ACS.C..C' check:", [v[v.find('CGCC'):v.find('CGCC')+16] for v in prot.values()])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.4))
reg=[r["omega"] for r in rows]; nmz=[r["region"] for r in rows]
bars=ax.bar(range(3),reg,color=["#8e44ad","#2980b9","#e67e22"])
ax.axhline(1.0,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.5); ax.text(2.45,1.03,"neutral (omega = 1)",color="#c0392b",fontsize=8,ha="right")
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    ax.text(i,r["omega"]+0.02,f"omega = {r['omega']}\ndN {r['dN']} / dS {r['dS']}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(nmz,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0,1.25)
ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS"); ax.set_title("Purifying selection on CG13494 is concentrated on the transmembrane helix\n(D. melanogaster vs D. sechellia, Nei-Gojobori with Jukes-Cantor correction)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
